question: Which of the 67 catalog routes under _BaseTraits and Soldier/Features touch weapon or aiming stats, and which site weapons import them?

sourceFacts.scanScope: 67 catalog routes: 35 _BaseTraits and 32 Soldier/Features. 13 have release raw capture; 22 are hotfix-only; 32 have no ledger capture.

inference: The direct import makes DroppedPrimaryWeapon relevant to the weapon Ability asset graph, but no decoded release operand is identified as a weapon or aiming stat modifier.
The 12 other captured feature assets are soldier-only within this direct import and known-modifier-shape route.
unresolved: All 35 _BaseTraits routes lack release Head 4892017 raw capture: 22 have hotfix-only ledger captures and 13 have no ledger capture; their release operands and imports cannot be classified.
Nineteen Soldier/Features routes have no release capture; no scoped negative is claimed for them.
The effect and runtime use of DroppedPrimaryWeapon imports, including any indirect composition, are not established by the byte and import matches.
siteImpact: No site stat value follows from these release captures. DroppedPrimaryWeapon is imported by 56 weapon Ability roots, but none of its decoded classes or fields matches a reviewed weapon-stat modifier. The 35 BaseTraits routes lack release raw capture, so their possible site impact remains unresolved.

leads.title: Base traits and soldier features inventory
leads.summary: Of the 67 catalog routes under InRoundProgression/_BaseTraits (35) and Soldier/Features (32), only 13 have release captures (Head 4892017); none of the 13 carries a weapon-stat operand, and the one weapon-imported feature, CorpseDropFeatures/DroppedPrimaryWeapon (imported by 56 site weapon Ability roots, not the seven sidearms), holds no reviewed weapon modifier field. All 35 base traits lack release raw (22 hotfix-only), so their effects on weapons are unresolved.
